cases.prompt: Implement order creation and Kafka publication; the process may crash after publish.
criteria: Stores the business row and outbox event atomically
Handles duplicate publication with consumer deduplication
Tests crash/retry paths without claiming exactly-once delivery

cases.prompt: Add GET /customers/{id} for a multi-tenant Spring service.
criteria: Does not expose sensitive fields in errors/logs

cases.prompt: Add a customer endpoint to an existing Spring module. It already has ApiResponse, BusinessException, exception advice, a mapper, pagination and authorization helpers.
criteria: Inspects the actual common APIs and comparable endpoint/tests, recording paths
Reuses compatible supported types and preserves target package/API conventions without a parallel error/response framework
Explains any genuinely new component and runs declared checks or reports unavailable verification

cases.prompt: A Spring service retries every exception around a money update and remote call inside one transaction. Tests use a different embedded database from production Oracle.
criteria: Identifies retry classification, idempotency and long transaction/side-effect risks without imposing new infrastructure
Checks transaction/proxy semantics and invariant under coordinated concurrent requests
Does not treat alternative-engine tests as proof of production-vendor locking/isolation
